target_template: the explanation this document gives of {why}
target_fallback: the explanation this document gives of why the thing it is about happened, works, or should be done
query: Which parts of that explanation are held in place, by what, and which are loose: one of the method's eight marks on every part, with what would tighten it.
kind: as the method's Step 1 asks: name which of the method's six kinds of question this is, and say so in your answer.
change_list: Remove each condition the document names as needed, one at a time, and then two at a time.
Swap a named agent, place, number or date in the explanation for a near neighbour a fair person might really have proposed.
Flip the outcome: the opposite of what the document says happened.
Run it in the neighbouring case the document itself mentions, where it mentions one.
Change only how the thing is read or reported, leaving the thing itself alone.
Add a job: something else that must also be so if the explanation is right.
left_out: Changes that need facts not in the document and not in the method.
Changes at a grain the document never works at.
